milestone_brief:
corpus-integrity-observability-e2 — Operators see corpus integrity in the daily report and in structured logs

Type: value. Size: S (<=1 wk). Depends on e1 (m1 + m2, BOTH SHIPPED): m1 made the
corpus-version.json marker counts table-derived; m2 added a startup reconciliation
invariant (Resources.startup_chunk_count cached count + WARN + /readyz degraded on
divergence) and two Prometheus gauges arxmcp_corpus_chunk_count_marker /
arxmcp_corpus_chunk_count_actual.

This epic makes corpus integrity HUMAN-VISIBLE at operator cadence. Three concrete,
testable deliverables:

1. (scout CAND-9) Daily ops report corpus-integrity row. The daily ops report (E14
   daily cadence; see tools/ + ops/ + tests/test_daily_metrics_report.py) gains a
   corpus-integrity row showing marker chunk_count vs actual count (+ corpus_version),
   reading the m2 gauges (arxmcp_corpus_chunk_count_marker / _actual) or the
   marker+table directly, and visibly flagging a divergence. Report-render snapshot test.

2. (scout CAND-6b — the BP1-FREE /readyz-body cut) The /readyz 200 "ready" body carries
   chunk_count and marker_chunk_count (from m2 Resources.startup_chunk_count +
   corpus_info.chunk_count). This is the /readyz-body form of CAND-6 — it does NOT add a
   get_corpus_status MCP tool (that stays on the Won't list). /readyz + /metrics are
   operational endpoints, NOT MCP surface: EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 +
   EXPECTED_BP1_SHA256 MUST stay frozen.

3. (scout CAND-4) Structured, test-assertable write-path log event + JSON logging
   selectable by default. The ingest write path (ingest/store.py::write_chunks, where the
   marker is written) emits a structured log event carrying assertable fields
   (corpus_version, chunk_count, paper_count). Structured JSON logging is selectable
   (config flag) and on by default per the scout. assertLogs/caplog test.

Won't conflict: the /readyz-body form is the BP1-free cut; the get_corpus_status MCP tool
stays on the Won't list. No new heavy infra (local-first).

Acceptance criteria:
- Daily ops report renders a corpus-integrity row (marker vs actual + corpus_version); a
  report-render snapshot/assertion test covers it.
- /readyz 200 body includes chunk_count and marker_chunk_count.
- Write path emits a structured, test-assertable log event (assertLogs/caplog); JSON
  structured logging is selectable and defaulted per the scout.
- EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 + EXPECTED_BP1_SHA256 UNCHANGED; make test green.

Specialist: none (health-endpoint + reporting + logging; no parser/schema/cache/subprocess
path — the adversary critic suffices).
